what_happened: During gate run phase12-final, Android's system_server was killed by its watchdog at 11:48:30 ('Blocked in monitor WindowManagerService ... for 71s'). The pre-watchdog dump shows the android.anim thread holding WindowManagerGlobalLock inside a synchronous binder call to SurfaceFlinger (BpSurfaceComposer::captureLayersSync, a task snapshot taken during a window transition) that never returned. Two TrackerFlowTest cases failed as a consequence (activity stuck in PAUSED). After the soft restart, /sdcard reported 'Transport endpoint is not connected'.
assessment: An emulator graphics-stack hang (SurfaceFlinger), consistent with the three earlier emulator hangs, two of which predate Phase 7. The same suites, including the FLAG_SECURE vault screens, passed in phase7-final and phase10-final.
steps: Stopped the emulator and started the same AVD with its original flags: -no-snapshot-load -no-snapshot-save.
Nothing was cleared, uninstalled, reseeded or installed in in.jansetu.app.
result: All four protected preview hashes are identical. The gate was archived as phase12-final-attempt1 and re-run.
